about.text: The whey drained off mabisi, a fermented milk of Zambia. It is used in cooking porridge, given to children to drink and fed to dogs and pigs. Instant mabisi, described in one paper only, is made by adding this whey to fresh raw milk, which curdles at once because the whey is acidic.

sources.text: Its uses, the seasonal discarding and instant mabisi, from this paper.
